entities.summary: Kazimierz Siemienowicz was a Polish–Lithuanian general of artillery, gunsmith, military engineer, and one of pioneers of rocketry. No portrait or detailed biography of him has survived and much of his life is a subject of dispute. Kazimierz Siemienowicz was a architects & engineers from Orshansky povet (1600, Orshansky povet–1651). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
